in_marathi.name: Bidesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Foreign, Exile, Travel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bidesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bidesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'videsh', meaning 'foreign', 'exile', or 'travel'. In Hindu mythology, Bidesh can refer to the idea of leaving one's comfort zone to explore new experiences and opportunities, embodying the spirit of adventure and exploration.
